item.title: Indigenous and environmental defenders risk their lives as the last line protecting the planet
item.description: Indigenous leaders, farmers, and environmental activists worldwide face harassment, violence, and legal threats while defending land, water, and ecosystems, highlighting the urgent need for stronger protections and international accountability.

item.title: Hegseth’s alleged war crime is the exact illegal order the 6 Democrats warned us about
item.description: Have Trump and Hegseth endorsed the commission of war crimes?

item.title: Instacart algorithms drive secret grocery price hikes
item.description: New report finds algorithm driven tests can charge shoppers up to 23 percent more for the same cart.

item.title: IDF chief signals intent to turn Gaza ceasefire line into new border
